summary: Enhancement 1 (Chennai availability gate / withdrawal / reactivation) verified end-to-end on hiring_ai_testing. Backend: main agent's 33-test suite + 5 safety regression suites = 83/83 pass; my independent suite test_e1_availability_iter64.py = 23/23 pass (GET config/404, YES/NO validation incl. 422 on >50-char other_text, nonce idempotency, OTP untouched, schedule 409 gate for null/NO/withdrawn and 200 after YES, booked YES->NO keeps booking + needs_hr_review surfaced in candidate-journey availability_block + cleared on YES, withdraw 400/409/idempotent, reactivate 409/400/422/yes, company-rejection 409, admin 401 unauth, reserved-ID 400, publish bumps version/versions/audit/draft rebased, eligibility WITHDRAWN/LATEST_AVAILABILITY_NO with null/true eligible and ordering intact, bg_workers filters). Frontend: gate shows first, slot picker hidden until YES persisted, NO->reason select, other->counter caps at 50/50, withdraw checkbox gates Confirm button, thank-you + reactivation after reload, booked NO notice, admin settings page (no useWorkflow error) tabs edit/preview/versions/audit, Save Draft + Publish via UI succeed, journey modal shows availability section with Needs HR Review badge. One real bug found: admin username always recorded as 'unknown'.

minor.issue: server.get_current_user returns a plain str username, but bb_availability.py extracts it via user.get('username')/getattr(user,'username') -> None -> 'unknown'. Result: audit rows and versions show 'by unknown' (seen in UI Versions/Audit tabs) and all admins share ONE draft doc keyed username='unknown'. Fix: username = user if isinstance(user, str) else (user.get('username') ...).

_validate_draft allows all reason options to be set active=false (incl. 'other') -> candidate can no longer submit NO at all (every reason 400). Enforce at least one active reason (ideally keep 'other' always active).

Non-atomic version bump: two concurrent publishes compute the same next_version; versions upsert uses $setOnInsert so the second publish's snapshot is lost while config holds the second content. Low risk (admin-only).

Read-then-update without a conditional filter (e.g. {withdrawn_by_candidate: {$ne: true}}); concurrent double-clicks can append two withdrawal/reactivation history rows when no nonce is sent (frontend never sends submission_nonce).
Pre-existing (not E1): public unauthenticated response includes the interview OTP ({"otp":"771427"}). Flagging for awareness only.

ui_bugs.issue: After Reactivate YES succeeds (backend already sets chennai_availability_latest=true), UI resets to the main 'ask' question instead of opening the slot picker; candidate must answer YES a second time.
Once NO radio is clicked the wizard switches to reason screen with no Back/Change-to-YES control; misclick requires page reload.
Choosing 'NO — Keep my application active' (wd-no) for a non-booked candidate shows nothing (dead end, no confirmation). 'Submit reason' button also remains visible after reason was saved.

issues: Page is not linked from sidebar or AI Calling menu (only reachable by typing URL)
'Publish New Version' button: dark green text on green background — low contrast
Booking date/time shown raw ('2030-04-07', '2030-04-07 11:00:00') instead of dd-mm-yyyy / hh:mm AM/PM used elsewhere on the same page
Errors surfaced via native window.alert instead of inline/toast

action_items: Fix username extraction in bb_availability.py (get_current_user returns str) so audit/versions/drafts record the real admin
After reactivation YES, hand off directly to slot picker (call onAllowBooking / setChoice(true)) instead of re-asking
Validate at least one active reason (keep 'other' active) in _validate_draft
Add sidebar/AI Calling link to /settings/interview-availability; fix Publish button contrast
Optional: atomic conditional updates for withdraw/reactivate/publish; send submission_nonce from frontend; Back button on reason screen; confirmation for 'keep active'; format booked date/time
critical_code_review_comments: bb_availability.py is 726 lines (>700) — consider splitting admin config endpoints into a separate module
Frontend never sends submission_nonce, so the unique-nonce idempotency only protects API clients that supply one
Schedule gate correctly placed before OTP lock; bg_workers 24h (L448) and missed (L551) filters exclude withdrawn only, NO-without-withdrawal still reminded as specified
candidate-journey availability_block lookup uses $or email/phone sorted by registered_at — if phone is shared across registrations it may surface another person's row

success_rate.backend: 100% (106/106 tests; 1 minor functional bug found by UI: admin username 'unknown')
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; reactivation UX double-ask)
